"import cadquery as cq

# Establish the XZ sketch plane
plane = cq.Plane.named("XZ")

# Helper: convert local sketch (u, v) -> world (u, 0, v)
def w(u, v):
    return plane.toWorldCoords((u, v))

# Key junction points for the closed profile
p_a = w(34, 0)        # Start of first line / end of spline
p_b = w(6, -20)       # Junction of the two lines
p_c = w(-34, 0)       # End of second line / start of spline

# Spline fit points (in order)
spline_pts = [
    w(-34, 0),
    w(-11.333333, 17),
    w(11.333333, 32),
    w(34, 0),
]

# Create exactly 3 curve entities: two lines and one fitted spline
line1 = cq.Edge.makeLine(p_a, p_b)
line2 = cq.Edge.makeLine(p_b, p_c)
spline = cq.Edge.makeSpline(spline_pts)

edges = [line1, line2, spline]

# Export the compound of edges to sketch.step
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
